cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On tomorrow's tour, say my diagram revealed the hidden doorway. You used to need me to write your introductions; try giving the right person the right verb.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum spent all week stripping that wall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Mum stripped; I spotted. Good guides keep those straight. You learned that on our first tour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll let you open it for the visitors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After you introduce me as the person who found it. Otherwise you've promoted me from your old teacher to the doorman.

reason: Tie an actual remembered teaching habit to the current pursuit, clarify inquiry stakes where absent, and give each partner contribution a consequential response. Differentiate adjacent cover-story scenes rather than repeat cupboard staging.
